compare_source:
Option Compare Text

Private Function Keys() As String
    Dim d As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    d.Add ChrW(&H3042), 1
    Keys = CStr(d.Exists(ChrW(&H30A2))) & " " & CStr(d.Exists(ChrW(&HFF71))) & " " & CStr(d.Exists(ChrW(&H3042)))
End Function

Private Function Cased(ByVal text As String) As String
    Select Case text
    Case "A": Cased = "case-blind"
    Case Else: Cased = "case-kept"
    End Select
End Function

Public Function Compare() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&H3042) = ChrW(&H30A2))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&HFF41) = "A")
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&H3042) < ChrW(&H30A4))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&HFF76) & ChrW(&HFF9E) = ChrW(&H30AC))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&HFF41) Like "a")
    s = s & "|" & CStr(ChrW(&H3042) Like ChrW(&H30A2))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(InStr(ChrW(&HFF41) & "b", "a"))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(InStrRev("b" & ChrW(&HFF41), "a", -1, vbTextCompare))
    s = s & "|" & Replace("x" & ChrW(&HFF41) & "y", "a", "-", , , vbTextCompare)
    s = s & "|" & CStr(UBound(Split("x" & ChrW(&HFF41) & "y", "a", , vbTextCompare)))
    s = s & "|" & Keys()
    s = s & "|" & CStr("a" = "A")
    s = s & "|" & CStr("a" < "B")
    s = s & "|" & CStr("b" > "A")
    s = s & "|" & CStr("a" Like "A")
    s = s & "|" & CStr("aB" Like "A*")
    s = s & "|" & CStr(InStr("xAy", "a"))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(InStr(1, "xAy", "a", vbBinaryCompare))
    s = s & "|" & CStr(StrComp("a", "A"))
    s = s & "|" & Replace("xAy", "a", "-")
    s = s & "|" & CStr(UBound(Split("xAy", "a")))
    s = s & "|" & Cased("a")
    Compare = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
names_source:
Private Function Named(ByVal which As String, ByVal wanted As String, ByVal folder As String, _
                       ByVal saved As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, t As ListObject, other As ListObject
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "h1": ws.Range("B1").Value = "h2": ws.Range("A2:B2").Value = 1
    ws.Range("D1").Value = "k": ws.Range("D2").Value = 2
    Set t = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    Set other = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("D1:D2"), , xlYes)
    other.DisplayName = "Other"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If which = "Name" Then t.Name = wanted Else t.DisplayName = wanted
    Named = t.Name & "/" & t.DisplayName & "/" & ws.ListObjects(1).Name
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\" & saved, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Named = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description & " / " & t.Name & "/" & t.DisplayName
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Names(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", ChrW(&H660E) & ChrW(&H7D30), folder, "name0.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", "a b", folder, "name1.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", "1abc", folder, "name2.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", "R1C1", folder, "name3.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", "Table1", folder, "name4.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("Name", "Other", folder, "name5.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", ChrW(&H660E) & ChrW(&H7D30), folder, "name6.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "a b", folder, "name7.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "1abc", folder, "name8.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "R1C1", folder, "name9.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "Tab.le", folder, "name10.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "_x", folder, "name11.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "A1", folder, "name12.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "Other", folder, "name13.xlsx")
    s = s & "@@@" & Named("DisplayName", "Caf" & ChrW(&HE9), folder, "name14.xlsx")
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Names = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
